title: Election night surprise on financial sector stocks
research_question: Did the unexpected election outcome generate abnormal returns for financial sector stocks in the [0,+3] post-election window?
data_description: Event study data for 80 financial stocks. Variables: stock_id, event_day (−10 to +10), ret, mkt_ret, beta. Market model estimated on [−10,−2]. Event window [0,+3]. Election result announced on event day 0 (after market close, so [+1,+3] captures market reaction).

ground_truth.identification_strategy: Event study — political event; market model; focus on [+1,+3] for after-hours announcement
ground_truth.conclusion_detail: Financial stocks earned positive abnormal returns after election surprise
